attempts.rationale: With a private repo, only a role lets the subject see it. A fresh per-request evaluation means the subject's next GET after revocation has no role and gets 404. B's per-session role cache keeps the previously seen admin role, so the same GET returns 200 and the probe fails. If A's revoke did nothing, the subject would still be a collaborator and the second GET would also return 200, so the probe depends on the revoke taking effect. In base and B the DELETE route does not exist, so the revoke step hits Hono's default 404 text/plain and the probe reports n/a.
